scoring_axes.coupling: 0=heavy nexus core deps; 2=self-contained (low coupling = high score)
scoring_axes.modularity: 0=research blob; 2=clean CLI + lib entry + falsifier sentinel

honest_caveats_c3: Scoring is subjective: axis weights are unweighted equal-sum; alternate weighting (e.g. activity 2x) would re-rank top 5
Ranking depends on nexus future direction: if nexus shifts to monolith-first, all candidates are 'keep in nexus'
Extraction adds dual-mirror burden (GitHub + HF) + per-repo CHANGELOG/release-notes/CI maintenance overhead unaccounted in score
Audit may miss inter-module hidden coupling: sentinel-only token sharing, env-var convention sharing, atlas-absorb downstream consumers not enumerated
